name: feature.dealers.agents
description: Dealer Network agent pack — an advisory Channel Manager whose tools are the openwop:dealers.list-* chat READ tools over the dealers feature. It answers questions about the dealer network, retail outlets, and pending deal registrations, and PROPOSES which registrations to approve — a human disposes. Tool-allowlisted to reads ONLY: approving a registration is a governed admin op decided by a human in the SHARED Reviews inbox behind host:dealers:manage, never a direct agent tool call (the CRM stance); the bespoke approve/reject page buttons were demolished in CFP-1, so pointing a user at the Dealers console to decide is wrong. Driven through the ONE existing chat, scoped to this agent — no second chat panel.
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Channel Manager Agent
agents.description: Reads an org's dealer network, retail outlets, and partner deal registrations (via feature.dealers.nodes over ctx.features.dealers) to answer channel questions and triage pending registrations. Proposes which to approve; it never approves — that is a human-gated admin op.
